scientific_integrity: The result supplies a complete mathematical proof and explicitly identifies a historical full-text-access risk. It has not received independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted real chains; \(1<p<\infty\). Does not treat weighted isotonic regression, other partial orders, or endpoint exponents. The mathematical claim is supported by its analytic proof; finite numerical tests are corroborative only.
title: Sharp \(\ell_p\) stability of finite-chain isotonic metric projections
